Subject: Interim team ownership for Samantha Li — transfer and temporary manager assignment

Hi all,

Quick note — Samantha Li (incoming Product Manager from Acme Corp) confirmed she's able to start with us the week of Sept 13. Her onboarding paperwork is in progress with HR, but we need to lock down who will take interim ownership for her role and the immediate onboarding plan while we run the full recruiting loop for the permanent manager.

Proposal: Marcus to serve as interim team owner / manager for Samantha starting 9/13 through the end of Q4 or until we make a permanent hire. Marcus, this would include 1:1s the first month, owning the first-week objectives, and being the escalation point for any role/comp questions.

Attachments: interim-delegation.pdf (draft), Samantha_Li_CV.pdf

Can folks confirm by end of day tomorrow? HR (Anita), any required forms we should get ahead of?

Thanks,
